comments: Rejected native reduction: standalone bush compresses to a tiny clump, not a readable advancing 179x11 band. Keep exact old danger fronts and safe plunger margin; needs a rerun at the requested aspect.
Only existing states are wired. All source rectangles and SHA-256 are retained.
geometry: Actual attack affects any ball y in inclusive [72,82] while Beat::Root, with direction from attack parity. Decorative crop is bounded between physics x=7 and 150; ball walls, not vines, bound traversal.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheet and measured components, 2026-10-15; supplemental poses retained separately.
